# update

Update records in a Dataverse entity (fails if record doesn't exist)

## Usage

```
ppds data update [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--batch-size` |  | `int` |  | Records per batch (default: 100) |
| `--bypass-flows` |  | `bool` |  | Bypass Power Automate flow triggers |
| `--bypass-plugins` |  | `string` |  | Bypass custom plugin execution: sync, async, or all (requires prvBypassCustomBusinessLogic privilege) |
| `--continue-on-error` |  | `bool` |  | Continue updating on individual record failures |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Preview records that would be updated without actually updating |
| `--entity` | `-e` | `string` |  | Target entity logical name |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--file` |  | `FileInfo` |  | Path to CSV file containing records to update (must include ID column and columns to update) |
| `--filter` |  | `string` |  | SQL-like filter expression to match records for update (e.g., "statecode eq 0") |
| `--force` |  | `bool` |  | Skip confirmation prompt (required for non-interactive execution) |
| `--id` |  | `Guid?` |  | Record ID (GUID) to update |
| `--id-column` |  | `string` |  | Column name containing record IDs in CSV file (default: entity primary key) |
| `--key` | `-k` | `string` |  | Alternate key field(s) for lookup. Format: field=value or field1=value1,field2=value2 for composite keys. |
| `--limit` |  | `int?` |  | Maximum number of records to update (fails if query returns more) |
| `--mapping` | `-m` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to column mapping JSON file (for --file mode) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Profile name(s). For high-throughput pooling, specify multiple Application User profiles comma-separated (e.g., app1,app2,app3) - each profile multiplies API quota. |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--set` | `-s` | `string` |  | Field values to set. Format: field=value or field1=value1,field2=value2. Required for --id, --key, or --filter modes. |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
